method: Two actual upper KSH 2003 map pixel footprints reproduced in the March 2008 municipal IVS: one estimated historical neighborhood candidate (Örökösföld lakótelep), one estimated local-area research candidate (Érkert housing-estate footprint). The lower 11-unit key does not directly label the upper 27-unit components; cross-schema assignments remain inferred. No merged group is cloned. Inferred affine from 11 municipal-outline corners to current OSM relation, with 10 same-outline held-out corners and no independent interior holdouts; unknown absolute accuracy. Current name points support name existence only, with outside-point disagreements retained. Per-feature candidateBoundaryKind remains mixed; no global kind override.
license: Municipal/KSH map open reuse rights unverified; ODbL-1.0 for OSM references.
rightsStatus: Public municipal publication; no independent open reuse licence established.
